title: Waterfronts and Work in Stockholm
description: A Stockholm trip split between waterfront walks and the city's modern business district. Grey skies made the harbour feel especially Nordic, while flashes of blue appeared between the glass buildings.
coverAlt: Historic buildings and a bridge lining Stockholm's waterfront beneath dramatic grey clouds

images.alt: Historic buildings and a busy bridge along Stockholm's waterfront, reflected in calm water beneath heavy grey clouds
images.caption: Stockholm's waterfront under a properly dramatic Nordic sky.

images.alt: Modern glass office building in central Stockholm with signs for Microsoft, Lovable and the Stockholm Chamber of Commerce beneath patches of blue sky
images.caption: Some familiar logos on Stockholm's modern business-district skyline.
